title: Cookie Catch
hook_caption: "Oops, I caught you eating my cookie!"
description: The curious little girl finds herself in a sticky situation as she discovers her father munching on a treat.

scenes.image_prompt: Big, round kitchen table where Dad is seated at a high chair with a plate of cookies, partially eaten but untouched by anyone else. Lily sits beside him on a nearby stool, holding onto a toy mouse.
scenes.action: Slow pull back from the action to show a close-up of Dad’s face with a surprised look mixed with guilt. Lily leans forward curiously.

dialogue.speaker: lily
dialogue.line: Oops, I caught you eating my cookie!

scenes.image_prompt: Dad has his hands over his mouth and nose, looking embarrassed. Lily points accusingly at him, her eyes wide with surprise.
scenes.action: Move Lily closer and more focused towards Dad. They share a tense moment. Slowly, they both turn away from each other, Lily standing proud with a slight blush.

dialogue.speaker: lily
dialogue.line: It’s okay, it was just a joke!

dialogue.speaker: daddy
dialogue.line: No worries, we’re partners in crime!

idea: baby catches daddy eating her cookies
